```{r}
# Groupings used in confusion matrices:
PrimaryModelTwo <- PrimaryModelTwo %>%
  mutate(Diagnosis_Grouped = case_when(
    Diagnosis %in% c("AN-R", "AT-AN-R", "AN-BP", "ARFID") ~ "Eating_Disorders",
    Diagnosis %in% c("PANDAS", "PANS") ~ "PANS_PANDAS", 
    Diagnosis == "OCD" ~ "OCD",
    Diagnosis == "HC" ~ "Healthy_Controls",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

PrimaryModelTwo <- PrimaryModelTwo %>%
  mutate(Diagnosis = case_when(
    Diagnosis %in% c("AN-R", "AT-AN-R", "AN-BP", "AT-AN-BP", "ARFID") ~ "AN/ARFID",
    TRUE ~ Diagnosis
  )) %>%
  filter(!(Diagnosis %in% c("PANS/COVID", "SC", "HC"))) ## Removing HCs 

protein_columns <- colnames(PrimaryModelTwo)[grep("4E-BP1|VEGFA", colnames(PrimaryModelTwo)):grep("VEGFA", colnames(PrimaryModelTwo))]

# Removing outlier proteins
proteins_to_remove <- c("CCL23", "CXCL5")
protein_columns <- setdiff(protein_columns, proteins_to_remove)

# Remove outlier IVIG study
PrimaryModelTwo <- PrimaryModelTwo %>% filter(`Protocol enrolled in` != "11-M-0058")
```

# Primary Model 2 PANDAS v.s. OCD v.s. ED

# 1. Classification Tree -- No Covariates

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Classification Tree -- No Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

tree_data <- PrimaryModelTwo[, c("Diagnosis", protein_columns)]
tree_data$Diagnosis <- gsub("AN/ARFID", "AN_ARFID", tree_data$Diagnosis)
tree_data$Diagnosis <- factor(tree_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID"))

class_counts <- table(tree_data$Diagnosis)
class_weights <- sum(class_counts) / (length(class_counts) * class_counts)
sample_weights <- class_weights[tree_data$Diagnosis]

td <- tree_data
colnames(td) <- make.names(colnames(td), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== DECISION TREE: PANDAS vs OCD vs AN/ARFID ==========\n\n")

cat("--- Tuning cp via One Standard Error Rule ---\n\n")

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                     number = 10,
                     repeats = 50,
                     classProbs = TRUE,
                     summaryFunction = multiClassSummary,
                     savePredictions = "all")

cp_grid <- expand.grid(cp = seq(0, 0.10, by = 0.005))

tree_cv <- caret::train(Diagnosis ~ .,
                        data = td,
                        method = "rpart",
                        trControl = ctrl,
                        metric = "Accuracy",
                        tuneGrid = cp_grid,
                        weights = sample_weights)

results <- tree_cv$results
best_acc <- max(results$Accuracy)
best_row <- which.max(results$Accuracy)
se_at_best <- results$AccuracySD[best_row] / sqrt(50)
threshold_1se <- best_acc - se_at_best

eligible <- results[results$Accuracy >= threshold_1se, ]
selected_cp <- max(eligible$cp)

cat("Best Accuracy:", round(best_acc, 4), "\n")
cat("Threshold (best - 1 SE):", round(threshold_1se, 4), "\n")
cat("Selected cp (simplest within 1 SE):", selected_cp, "\n")
cat("Accuracy at selected cp:", round(results$Accuracy[results$cp == selected_cp], 4), "\n\n")

cat("--- Final Tree (cp =", selected_cp, ") ---\n\n")

tree_model <- rpart(Diagnosis ~ ., data = tree_data, method = "class",
                    control = rpart.control(cp = selected_cp),
                    weights = sample_weights)

rpart.plot(tree_model, type = 3, extra = 1, under = TRUE, cex = 0.6,
           main = paste("Decision Tree (cp =", selected_cp, ")"))

cat("Variables used in tree:\n")
print(tree_model$variable.importance)

cat("\n--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

oof <- tree_cv$pred
oof_best <- oof[oof$cp == selected_cp, ]

cat("--- 3-Class Confusion Matrix ---\n")
cm_3class <- table(Predicted = factor(oof_best$pred, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")),
                   Actual = factor(oof_best$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")))
print(cm_3class)
cat("Overall Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n\n")

oof_best$PANDAS_binary <- ifelse(oof_best$obs == "PANDAS", 1, 0)

roc_pandas <- roc(response = oof_best$PANDAS_binary, predictor = oof_best$PANDAS, levels = c(0, 1))
roc_fig2_tree <- roc_pandas
plot(roc_pandas, main = paste("PANDAS vs Rest ROC (cp =", selected_cp, ")"))
auc_pandas <- auc(roc_pandas)

multiclass_roc <- multiclass.roc(response = oof_best$obs, predictor = as.matrix(oof_best[, c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")]))
auc_multiclass <- auc(multiclass_roc)

youden <- coords(roc_pandas, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"), best.method = "youden")
cat("Youden's optimal threshold:", round(youden$threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity at Youden:", round(youden$sensitivity, 3), "| Specificity:", round(youden$specificity, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05 <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.5, 1, 0)
pred_085 <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.85, 1, 0)
pred_youden <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= youden$threshold, 1, 0)

pred_05 <- factor(pred_05, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_085 <- factor(pred_085, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_youden <- factor(pred_youden, levels = c(1, 0))
actual_binary <- factor(oof_best$PANDAS_binary, levels = c(1, 0))

cm_05 <- table(Predicted = pred_05, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_085 <- table(Predicted = pred_085, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_youden <- table(Predicted = pred_youden, Actual = actual_binary)

sens_05 <- cm_05[1, 1] / sum(cm_05[, 1])
spec_05 <- cm_05[2, 2] / sum(cm_05[, 2])
sens_085 <- cm_085[1, 1] / sum(cm_085[, 1])
spec_085 <- cm_085[2, 2] / sum(cm_085[, 2])
sens_youden <- cm_youden[1, 1] / sum(cm_youden[, 1])
spec_youden <- cm_youden[2, 2] / sum(cm_youden[, 2])

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
print(cm_05)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold =", round(youden$threshold, 3), ", Youden) ---\n")
print(cm_youden)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_youden, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
print(cm_085)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n\n")

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_pandas), 3), "\n")
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n")
cat("3-Class Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n")
cat("Final model uses cp =", selected_cp, "(selected via one standard error rule).\n")
cat("At threshold 0.5: Sensitivity =", round(sens_05, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")
cat("At Youden threshold (", round(youden$threshold, 3), "): Sensitivity =", round(sens_youden, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.85: Sensitivity =", round(sens_085, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")
```

## 3.1 Feature Selection

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.1 Feature Selection
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

cat("\n========== NESTED CROSS-VALIDATION FOR FEATURE SELECTION (AIM 2) ==========\n\n")

protein_columns2 <- names(PrimaryModelTwo)[which(names(PrimaryModelTwo) == "4E-BP1"):which(names(PrimaryModelTwo) == "VEGFA")]
protein_columns2 <- setdiff(protein_columns2, c("CCL23", "CXCL5"))

multi_raw <- PrimaryModelTwo %>%
  dplyr::select(`Unique Sample ID`, Visit, Diagnosis, `Age at First Sample`) %>%
  left_join(NPX_raw %>% dplyr::select(-QC_Warning), by = c("Unique Sample ID", "Visit"))

df2_raw <- multi_raw[, c("Diagnosis", "Age at First Sample", protein_columns2)]
colnames(df2_raw) <- make.names(colnames(df2_raw))
protein_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df2_raw), c("Diagnosis", "Age.at.First.Sample"))
df2_raw$Diagnosis <- factor(gsub("/", "_", as.character(df2_raw$Diagnosis)), levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID"))

yj_all2 <- preProcess(df2_raw[, protein_cols], method = "YeoJohnson")
yj_all_data2 <- as.matrix(predict(yj_all2, df2_raw[, protein_cols]))
age_all2 <- df2_raw$Age.at.First.Sample
resid_all2 <- yj_all_data2 - cbind(1, age_all2) %*% coef(lm(yj_all_data2 ~ age_all2))

df2 <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df2_raw$Diagnosis, resid_all2)

multi_prep <- as.data.frame(multi_raw[, c("Unique Sample ID", "Diagnosis")])
multi_prep[, protein_columns2] <- as.data.frame(resid_all2)

# Custom caret model so the YJ transform and age residuals are refit inside each training fold
rf_infold <- getModelInfo("rf", regex = FALSE)[[1]]

rf_infold$fit <- function(x, y, wts, param, lev, last, classProbs, ...) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  age <- x$Age.at.First.Sample
  prot <- x[, colnames(x) != "Age.at.First.Sample", drop = FALSE]
  yj <- preProcess(prot, method = "YeoJohnson")
  prot_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, prot))
  age_coef <- coef(lm(prot_yj ~ age))
  prot_resid <- prot_yj - cbind(1, age) %*% age_coef
  model <- randomForest(x = prot_resid, y = y, mtry = min(param$mtry, ncol(prot_resid)), ...)
  model$yj <- yj
  model$age_coef <- age_coef
  model
}

rf_infold$predict <- function(modelFit, newdata, submodels = NULL) {
  newdata <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  age <- newdata$Age.at.First.Sample
  prot <- newdata[, colnames(newdata) != "Age.at.First.Sample", drop = FALSE]
  prot_resid <- as.matrix(predict(modelFit$yj, prot)) - cbind(1, age) %*% modelFit$age_coef
  predict(modelFit, prot_resid)
}

rf_infold$prob <- function(modelFit, newdata, submodels = NULL) {
  newdata <- as.data.frame(newdata)
  age <- newdata$Age.at.First.Sample
  prot <- newdata[, colnames(newdata) != "Age.at.First.Sample", drop = FALSE]
  prot_resid <- as.matrix(predict(modelFit$yj, prot)) - cbind(1, age) %*% modelFit$age_coef
  predict(modelFit, prot_resid, type = "prob")
}

outer_folds <- createFolds(df2_raw$Diagnosis, k = 10, returnTrain = FALSE)

outer_predictions <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:10) {
  
  cat("Outer fold", i, "of 10\n")
  
  test_idx <- outer_folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(df2_raw), test_idx)
  
  yj <- preProcess(df2_raw[train_idx, protein_cols], method = "YeoJohnson")
  train_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, df2_raw[train_idx, protein_cols]))
  test_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, df2_raw[test_idx, protein_cols]))
  
  age_train <- df2_raw$Age.at.First.Sample[train_idx]
  age_test <- df2_raw$Age.at.First.Sample[test_idx]
  age_fit <- lm(train_yj ~ age_train)
  train_resid <- train_yj - cbind(1, age_train) %*% coef(age_fit)
  test_resid <- test_yj - cbind(1, age_test) %*% coef(age_fit)
  
  train_data <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df2_raw$Diagnosis[train_idx], train_resid)
  test_data <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df2_raw$Diagnosis[test_idx], test_resid)
  
  class_counts_inner <- table(train_data$Diagnosis)
  class_weights_inner <- sum(class_counts_inner) / (length(class_counts_inner) * class_counts_inner)
  
  rf_full <- randomForest(
    Diagnosis ~ .,
    data = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = floor(sqrt(length(protein_cols))),
    classwt = class_weights_inner
  )
  
  importance_inner <- data.frame(
    Feature = rownames(importance(rf_full)),
    Importance = importance(rf_full)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  ctrl_inner <- trainControl(
    method = "cv",
    number = 10,
    classProbs = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = multiClassSummary,
    savePredictions = "final"
  )
  
  k_grid <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)
  k_perf <- data.frame()
  
  for (k in k_grid) {
    top_k <- importance_inner$Feature[1:k]
    train_k <- train_data[, c("Diagnosis", top_k)]
    
    rf_k <- caret::train(
      Diagnosis ~ .,
      data = train_k,
      method = "rf",
      trControl = ctrl_inner,
      metric = "Accuracy",
      tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = floor(sqrt(k))),
      ntree = 500,
      classwt = class_weights_inner
    )
    
    oof_k <- rf_k$pred
    oof_k$PANDAS_binary <- ifelse(oof_k$obs == "PANDAS", 1, 0)
    fold_aucs <- sapply(split(oof_k, oof_k$Resample), function(x) as.numeric(auc(roc(response = x$PANDAS_binary, predictor = x$PANDAS, levels = c(0, 1), quiet = TRUE))))
    
    k_perf <- rbind(k_perf, data.frame(k = k, AUC = mean(fold_aucs), SD = sd(fold_aucs)))
  }
  
  best_AUC <- max(k_perf$AUC)
  best_SD <- k_perf$SD[which.max(k_perf$AUC)]
  eligible_k <- k_perf$k[k_perf$AUC >= best_AUC - best_SD]
  chosen_k <- min(eligible_k)
  
  cat("  Chosen k =", chosen_k, "\n")
  
  selected_features <- importance_inner$Feature[1:chosen_k]
  
  train_final <- train_data[, c("Diagnosis", selected_features)]
  test_final <- test_data[, c("Diagnosis", selected_features)]
  
  rf_final <- randomForest(
    Diagnosis ~ .,
    data = train_final,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = floor(sqrt(chosen_k)),
    classwt = class_weights_inner
  )
  
  test_probs <- predict(rf_final, test_final, type = "prob")
  
  fold_preds <- data.frame(
    obs = test_data$Diagnosis,
    PANDAS = test_probs[, "PANDAS"],
    OCD = test_probs[, "OCD"],
    AN_ARFID = test_probs[, "AN_ARFID"],
    pred = predict(rf_final, test_final),
    outer_fold = i,
    chosen_k = chosen_k
  )
  
  outer_predictions <- rbind(outer_predictions, fold_preds)
}

cat("\n========== NESTED CV RESULTS ==========\n\n")

outer_predictions$PANDAS_binary <- ifelse(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS", 1, 0)
roc_nested <- roc(response = outer_predictions$PANDAS_binary, predictor = outer_predictions$PANDAS, levels = c(0, 1))
auc_nested <- as.numeric(auc(roc_nested))

cat("Nested CV PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(auc_nested, 3), "\n\n")

cm_nested <- table(Predicted = outer_predictions$pred, Actual = outer_predictions$obs)
cat("3-Class Confusion Matrix:\n")
print(cm_nested)
cat("\n3-Class Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_nested)) / sum(cm_nested), 3), "\n")

cat("\nFeatures selected per fold:\n")
print(table(outer_predictions$chosen_k))

coords_nested <- coords(roc_nested, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"))
youden_thresh <- coords_nested$threshold

cat("\nOptimal threshold (Youden):", round(youden_thresh, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(coords_nested$sensitivity, 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(coords_nested$specificity, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
outer_predictions$pred_0.5 <- ifelse(outer_predictions$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")
print(table(Predicted = outer_predictions$pred_0.5, Actual = ifelse(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS", "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")))
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_0.5 == "PANDAS" & outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS"), 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_0.5 == "Not-PANDAS" & outer_predictions$obs != "PANDAS") / sum(outer_predictions$obs != "PANDAS"), 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold =", round(youden_thresh, 3), ", Youden) ---\n")
outer_predictions$pred_youden <- ifelse(outer_predictions$PANDAS >= youden_thresh, "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")
print(table(Predicted = outer_predictions$pred_youden, Actual = ifelse(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS", "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")))
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_youden == "PANDAS" & outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS") / sum(outer_predictions$obs == "PANDAS"), 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(sum(outer_predictions$pred_youden == "Not-PANDAS" & outer_predictions$obs != "PANDAS") / sum(outer_predictions$obs != "PANDAS"), 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
feature_tracker2 <- list()

set.seed(2025)

for (r in 1:10) {

  outer_folds_r <- createFolds(df2_raw$Diagnosis, k = 10, returnTrain = FALSE)

  for (i in 1:10) {

    test_idx <- outer_folds_r[[i]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(df2_raw), test_idx)

    yj <- preProcess(df2_raw[train_idx, protein_cols], method = "YeoJohnson")
    train_yj <- as.matrix(predict(yj, df2_raw[train_idx, protein_cols]))

    age_train <- df2_raw$Age.at.First.Sample[train_idx]
    age_fit <- lm(train_yj ~ age_train)
    train_resid <- train_yj - cbind(1, age_train) %*% coef(age_fit)

    train_data <- data.frame(Diagnosis = df2_raw$Diagnosis[train_idx], train_resid)

    class_counts_inner <- table(train_data$Diagnosis)
    class_weights_inner <- sum(class_counts_inner) / (length(class_counts_inner) * class_counts_inner)

    rf_full <- randomForest(
      Diagnosis ~ .,
      data = train_data,
      ntree = 500,
      mtry = floor(sqrt(length(protein_cols))),
      classwt = class_weights_inner
    )

    importance_inner <- data.frame(
      Feature = rownames(importance(rf_full)),
      Importance = importance(rf_full)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))

    feature_tracker2[[length(feature_tracker2) + 1]] <- importance_inner$Feature[1:5]
  }
}

all_selected2 <- unlist(feature_tracker2)
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.1.5 Extended Model

set.seed(2025)

# The 7 proteins that were in the top 5 in at least one fold
top7_features <- c("OSM", "TGF.alpha", "HGF", "TNFSF14", "EN.RAGE", "VEGFA", "IL8")
rf7 <- df2_raw[, c("Diagnosis", "Age.at.First.Sample", top7_features)]

class_counts7 <- table(rf7$Diagnosis)
class_weights7 <- sum(class_counts7) / (length(class_counts7) * class_counts7)

ctrl_50 <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                        number = 10,
                        repeats = 50,
                        classProbs = TRUE,
                        summaryFunction = multiClassSummary,
                        savePredictions = "all")

rf_cv7 <- caret::train(
  Diagnosis ~ .,
  data = rf7,
  method = rf_infold,
  trControl = ctrl_50,
  metric = "Accuracy",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = round(sqrt(7))),
  ntree = 1000,
  classwt = class_weights7
)

cat("\n===== FINAL RF MODEL WITH TOP 7 FEATURES (50x10 CV, 1000 trees) =====\n")
print(rf_cv7)

oof7 <- rf_cv7$pred

oof7$PANDAS_binary <- ifelse(oof7$obs == "PANDAS", 1, 0)
roc7 <- roc(
  response = oof7$PANDAS_binary,
  predictor = oof7$PANDAS,
  levels = c(0, 1)
)

plot(roc7, main = "ROC Curve: PANDAS vs Rest (Top 7 Proteins, 50x10 CV)")

auc7 <- auc(roc7)
auc7_sd <- sd(sapply(split(oof7, oof7$Resample), function(x) {
  if(length(unique(x$PANDAS_binary)) < 2) return(NA)
  as.numeric(auc(roc(response = x$PANDAS_binary, predictor = x$PANDAS, levels = c(0, 1), quiet = TRUE)))
}), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nPANDAS vs Rest AUC (Top 7):", round(as.numeric(auc7), 3),
    "(SD:", round(auc7_sd, 3), ")\n")

cat("3-Class Accuracy:", round(mean(rf_cv7$resample$Accuracy), 3),
    "(SD:", round(sd(rf_cv7$resample$Accuracy), 3), ")\n")

coords7 <- coords(roc7, "best", best.method = "youden")
thresh7 <- coords7$threshold
sens7 <- coords7$sensitivity
spec7 <- coords7$specificity

cat("\nOptimal threshold (Youden):", round(thresh7, 3),
    "| Sens:", round(sens7, 3),
    "| Spec:", round(spec7, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- 3-Class Confusion Matrix ---\n")
cm_3class <- table(Predicted = oof7$pred, Actual = oof7$obs)
print(cm_3class)
cat("3-Class Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
pred_05 <- ifelse(oof7$PANDAS >= 0.5, "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")
actual_binary <- ifelse(oof7$obs == "PANDAS", "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")
cm_05 <- table(Predicted = pred_05, Actual = actual_binary)
print(cm_05)
sens_05 <- cm_05["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_05[, "PANDAS"])
spec_05 <- cm_05["Not-PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS"] / sum(cm_05[, "Not-PANDAS"])
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold =", round(thresh7, 3), ", Youden) ---\n")
pred_youden <- ifelse(oof7$PANDAS >= thresh7, "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")
cm_youden <- table(Predicted = pred_youden, Actual = actual_binary)
print(cm_youden)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens7, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec7, 3), "\n")

cat("\n--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
pred_85 <- ifelse(oof7$PANDAS >= 0.85, "PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS")
cm_85 <- table(Predicted = pred_85, Actual = actual_binary)
print(cm_85)
sens_85 <- cm_85["PANDAS", "PANDAS"] / sum(cm_85[, "PANDAS"])
spec_85 <- cm_85["Not-PANDAS", "Not-PANDAS"] / sum(cm_85[, "Not-PANDAS"])
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_85, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_85, 3), "\n")

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("The Random Forest with top 7 proteins achieved a PANDAS vs Rest AUC of", round(as.numeric(auc7), 3), 
    "(SD:", round(auc7_sd, 3), ") in 10-fold cross-validation (50 repeats).\n")
cat("At the optimal threshold of", round(thresh7, 3), "(Youden's index), the model achieved", 
    round(sens7 * 100, 1), "% sensitivity and", round(spec7 * 100, 1), "% specificity.\n")

importance_df7 <- data.frame(
  Protein = rownames(rf_cv7$finalModel$importance),
  Importance = rf_cv7$finalModel$importance[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Importance))

print(importance_df7)
```

### 3.2.1 Simulations

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.2.1 Simulations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n========== PATIENT SIMULATIONS (7-PROTEIN PANEL) ==========\n\n")

set.seed(2025)

rf7_sim <- df2[, c("Diagnosis", top7_features)]
rf_model7 <- rf_cv7$finalModel
protein_cols7 <- top7_features

cov_matrix7 <- cov(rf7_sim[, protein_cols7])

rf7_with_probs <- rf7_sim
rf7_with_probs$prob_PANDAS <- rf_model7$votes[, "PANDAS"]
rf7_with_probs$original_diagnosis <- rf7_sim$Diagnosis

pandas_patients <- rf7_with_probs[rf7_with_probs$original_diagnosis == "PANDAS", ]
ocd_patients <- rf7_with_probs[rf7_with_probs$original_diagnosis == "OCD", ]
anarfid_patients <- rf7_with_probs[rf7_with_probs$original_diagnosis == "AN_ARFID", ]

templates <- rbind(
  ocd_patients[which.min(abs(ocd_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(ocd_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.10))), ],
  ocd_patients[which.min(abs(ocd_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(ocd_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.50))), ],
  ocd_patients[which.min(abs(ocd_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(ocd_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.90))), ],
  anarfid_patients[which.min(abs(anarfid_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(anarfid_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.10))), ],
  anarfid_patients[which.min(abs(anarfid_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(anarfid_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.50))), ],
  anarfid_patients[which.min(abs(anarfid_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(anarfid_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.90))), ],
  pandas_patients[which.min(abs(pandas_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(pandas_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.10))), ],
  pandas_patients[which.min(abs(pandas_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(pandas_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.50))), ],
  pandas_patients[which.min(abs(pandas_patients$prob_PANDAS - quantile(pandas_patients$prob_PANDAS, 0.90))), ]
)

patient_labels <- c(
  "OCD, low predicted probability",
  "OCD, intermediate predicted probability",
  "OCD, high predicted probability",
  "R-ED, low predicted probability",
  "R-ED, intermediate predicted probability",
  "R-ED, high predicted probability",
  "PANDAS, low predicted probability",
  "PANDAS, intermediate predicted probability",
  "PANDAS, high predicted probability"
)

n_perturb <- 100
stability_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(templates)) {
  base <- templates[i, ]
  probs <- numeric(n_perturb)

  for (j in 1:n_perturb) {
    # Noise is 15% of the SD and keeps the correlation between proteins
    noise <- mvrnorm(1, mu = rep(0, length(protein_cols7)), Sigma = cov_matrix7 * 0.15^2)
    variant <- base[, protein_cols7]
    variant[1, ] <- as.numeric(variant) + noise
    probs[j] <- predict(rf_model7, variant, type = "prob")[, "PANDAS"]
  }

  stability_results <- rbind(stability_results, data.frame(
    Patient = patient_labels[i],
    True_Diagnosis = gsub("AN_ARFID", "R-ED", as.character(base$original_diagnosis)),
    Template_P_PANDAS = base$prob_PANDAS,
    Mean_P_PANDAS = mean(probs),
    SD_P_PANDAS = sd(probs),
    Cross_0.5 = sum(probs >= 0.5),
    Cross_Youden = sum(probs >= thresh7),
    Cross_0.85 = sum(probs >= 0.85)
  ))
}

print(stability_results)
```

```{r}
sim_table <- stability_results[, c("Patient", "Mean_P_PANDAS", "SD_P_PANDAS", "Cross_0.5", "Cross_Youden", "Cross_0.85")]

sim_table$Mean_P_PANDAS <- round(sim_table$Mean_P_PANDAS, 2)
sim_table$SD_P_PANDAS <- round(sim_table$SD_P_PANDAS, 2)

kable(sim_table,
      col.names = c("Patient Profile", "Mean P(PANDAS)", "SD",
                    "0.50, %",
                    paste0("Youden (", round(thresh7, 2), "), %"),
                    "High-Specificity (0.85), %"),
      row.names = FALSE,
      caption = "Table X. Stability of PANDAS Classification Under Local Perturbation (n = 100 simulations per profile)",
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "% Crossing Threshold" = 3)) %>%
  footnote(general = "Perturbations added Gaussian noise proportional to protein variance while preserving correlation structure.")
```

### 3.2.5 Interpretability

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.2.5 Interpretability
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n========== RANDOM FOREST INTERPRETABILITY (AIM 2) ==========\n\n")

cat("--- 1. Direction of Effect (Mean Protein Levels by Diagnosis) ---\n\n")

top7_proteins <- top7_features
rf7_data <- df2[, c("Diagnosis", top7_features)]

direction_df7 <- data.frame(Protein = top7_proteins)

direction_df7$Mean_PANDAS <- sapply(top7_proteins, function(p) mean(rf7_data[[p]][rf7_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS"]))
direction_df7$Mean_OCD <- sapply(top7_proteins, function(p) mean(rf7_data[[p]][rf7_data$Diagnosis == "OCD"]))
direction_df7$Mean_ED <- sapply(top7_proteins, function(p) mean(rf7_data[[p]][rf7_data$Diagnosis == "AN_ARFID"]))

direction_df7$SD_PANDAS <- sapply(top7_proteins, function(p) sd(rf7_data[[p]][rf7_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS"]))
direction_df7$SD_OCD <- sapply(top7_proteins, function(p) sd(rf7_data[[p]][rf7_data$Diagnosis == "OCD"]))
direction_df7$SD_ED <- sapply(top7_proteins, function(p) sd(rf7_data[[p]][rf7_data$Diagnosis == "AN_ARFID"]))

direction_df7$Diff_vs_OCD <- direction_df7$Mean_PANDAS - direction_df7$Mean_OCD
direction_df7$Diff_vs_ED <- direction_df7$Mean_PANDAS - direction_df7$Mean_ED

direction_df7$Cohen_d_vs_OCD <- direction_df7$Diff_vs_OCD / sqrt((direction_df7$SD_PANDAS^2 + direction_df7$SD_OCD^2) / 2)
direction_df7$Cohen_d_vs_ED <- direction_df7$Diff_vs_ED / sqrt((direction_df7$SD_PANDAS^2 + direction_df7$SD_ED^2) / 2)

direction_df7 <- merge(importance_df7, direction_df7, by = "Protein")
direction_df7 <- direction_df7[order(-direction_df7$Importance), ]

cat("Top 7 Proteins - Direction and Effect Size:\n\n")
print(direction_df7[, c("Protein", "Importance", "Mean_PANDAS", "Mean_OCD", "Mean_ED", "Cohen_d_vs_OCD", "Cohen_d_vs_ED")])
```

# 4. Random Forest -- With Covariates

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Random Forest -- With Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

PrimaryModelTwo <- PrimaryModelTwo %>% mutate(Race = as.factor(Race), Ethnicity = as.factor(Ethnicity), Sex = as.factor(Sex))

rf_data <- PrimaryModelTwo[, c("Diagnosis", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Sex", protein_columns)]
rf_data <- rf_data[complete.cases(rf_data), ]
rf_data$Diagnosis <- gsub("AN/ARFID", "AN_ARFID", rf_data$Diagnosis)
rf_data$Diagnosis <- factor(rf_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID"))

class_counts <- table(rf_data$Diagnosis)
class_weights <- sum(class_counts) / (length(class_counts) * class_counts)

rd <- rf_data
colnames(rd) <- make.names(colnames(rd), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== RANDOM FOREST WITH DEMOGRAPHICS: PANDAS vs OCD vs AN_ARFID ==========\n\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(rf_data), "\n")
print(table(rf_data$Diagnosis))
cat("\n")

cat("--- Cross-Validation Setup ---\n")
cat("Method: 10-fold CV with 10 repeats\n")
cat("mtry: sqrt(p) =", round(sqrt(length(protein_columns) + 3)), "\n")
cat("ntree: 500\n\n")

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                     number = 10,
                     repeats = 10,
                     classProbs = TRUE,
                     summaryFunction = multiClassSummary,
                     savePredictions = "all")

rf_cv <- caret::train(Diagnosis ~ .,
                      data = rd,
                      method = "rf",
                      trControl = ctrl,
                      metric = "Accuracy",
                      tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = round(sqrt(length(protein_columns) + 3))),
                      ntree = 500,
                      classwt = class_weights)

print(rf_cv)

cat("\n--- Final Random Forest ---\n\n")

rf_model <- randomForest(Diagnosis ~ ., 
                         data = rd, 
                         ntree = 500, 
                         mtry = round(sqrt(length(protein_columns) + 3)), 
                         importance = TRUE, 
                         classwt = class_weights)

print(rf_model)

cat("\n--- OOB Error Curve ---\n\n")
plot(rf_model, main = "OOB Error Rate by Number of Trees")
legend("topright", colnames(rf_model$err.rate), col = 1:4, lty = 1:4)

varImpPlot(rf_model, main = "Variable Importance - Random Forest with Demographics")

cat("\n--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

oof <- rf_cv$pred

cat("--- 3-Class Confusion Matrix ---\n")
cm_3class <- table(Predicted = factor(oof$pred, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")),
                   Actual = factor(oof$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")))
print(cm_3class)
cat("Overall Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n\n")

oof$PANDAS_binary <- ifelse(oof$obs == "PANDAS", 1, 0)

roc_pandas <- roc(response = oof$PANDAS_binary, predictor = oof$PANDAS, levels = c(0, 1))
roc_fig2_rf_cov <- roc_pandas

plot(roc_pandas, main = "PANDAS vs Rest ROC - Random Forest with Demographics")
auc_pandas <- auc(roc_pandas)

multiclass_roc <- multiclass.roc(response = oof$obs, predictor = as.matrix(oof[, c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")]))
auc_multiclass <- auc(multiclass_roc)

cat("PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_pandas), 3), "\n")
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n\n")

youden <- coords(roc_pandas, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"), best.method = "youden")
cat("--- Optimal Threshold (Youden's Index) ---\n")
cat("Threshold:", round(youden$threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(youden$sensitivity, 3), "| Specificity:", round(youden$specificity, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05 <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= 0.5, 1, 0)
pred_085 <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= 0.85, 1, 0)
pred_youden <- ifelse(oof$PANDAS >= youden$threshold, 1, 0)

pred_05 <- factor(pred_05, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_085 <- factor(pred_085, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_youden <- factor(pred_youden, levels = c(1, 0))
actual_binary <- factor(oof$PANDAS_binary, levels = c(1, 0))

cm_05 <- table(Predicted = pred_05, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_085 <- table(Predicted = pred_085, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_youden <- table(Predicted = pred_youden, Actual = actual_binary)

sens_05 <- cm_05[1, 1] / sum(cm_05[, 1])
spec_05 <- cm_05[2, 2] / sum(cm_05[, 2])
sens_085 <- cm_085[1, 1] / sum(cm_085[, 1])
spec_085 <- cm_085[2, 2] / sum(cm_085[, 2])
sens_youden <- cm_youden[1, 1] / sum(cm_youden[, 1])
spec_youden <- cm_youden[2, 2] / sum(cm_youden[, 2])

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
print(cm_05)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold =", round(youden$threshold, 3), ", Youden) ---\n")
print(cm_youden)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_youden, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
print(cm_085)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n\n")

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_pandas), 3), "\n")
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n")
cat("3-Class Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.5: Sensitivity =", round(sens_05, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")
cat("At Youden threshold (", round(youden$threshold, 3), "): Sensitivity =", round(sens_youden, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.85: Sensitivity =", round(sens_085, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
print(cm_youden)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_youden, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
print(cm_085)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n\n")

cat("\n--- Variable Importance (Permutation-based) ---\n\n")

library(iml)
conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

predictor <- Predictor$new(svm_model, data = sd[, -1], y = sd$Diagnosis)
feat_imp <- FeatureImp$new(predictor, loss = "ce")
plot(feat_imp)

detach("package:iml", unload = TRUE)

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("Best tuning parameters: C =", svm_cv$bestTune$C, ", sigma =", round(svm_cv$bestTune$sigma, 4), "\n")
cat("PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_pandas), 3), "\n")
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n")
cat("3-Class Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.5: Sensitivity =", round(sens_05, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")

cat("At threshold 0.85: Sensitivity =", round(sens_085, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")
```

# 6. SVM -- With Covariates

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. SVM -- With Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

PrimaryModelTwo <- PrimaryModelTwo %>% mutate(Race = as.factor(Race), Ethnicity = as.factor(Ethnicity), Sex = as.factor(Sex))

svm_data <- PrimaryModelTwo[, c("Diagnosis", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Sex", protein_columns)]
svm_data <- svm_data[complete.cases(svm_data), ]
svm_data$Diagnosis <- gsub("AN/ARFID", "AN_ARFID", svm_data$Diagnosis)
svm_data$Diagnosis <- factor(svm_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID"))

sd <- svm_data
colnames(sd) <- make.names(colnames(sd), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== SVM (RADIAL) WITH DEMOGRAPHICS: PANDAS vs OCD vs AN_ARFID ==========\n\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(svm_data), "\n")
print(table(svm_data$Diagnosis))
cat("\n")

cat("--- Cross-Validation Setup ---\n")
cat("Method: 10-fold CV with 10 repeats\n")
cat("Kernel: Radial basis function\n")
cat("Preprocessing: Centered and scaled\n\n")

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                     number = 10,
                     repeats = 10,
                     classProbs = TRUE,
                     summaryFunction = multiClassSummary,
                     savePredictions = "all")

svm_cv <- caret::train(Diagnosis ~ .,
                       data = sd,
                       method = "svmRadial",
                       trControl = ctrl,
                       metric = "Accuracy",
                       preProcess = c("center", "scale"))

print(svm_cv)

cat("\n--- Final SVM Model ---\n\n")

svm_model <- svm(Diagnosis ~ ., 
                 data = sd,
                 kernel = "radial",
                 probability = TRUE,
                 scale = TRUE)

print(svm_model)

cat("\n--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

oof <- svm_cv$pred
oof_best <- oof[oof$C == svm_cv$bestTune$C & oof$sigma == svm_cv$bestTune$sigma, ]

cat("--- 3-Class Confusion Matrix ---\n")
cm_3class <- table(Predicted = factor(oof_best$pred, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")),
                   Actual = factor(oof_best$obs, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")))
print(cm_3class)
cat("Overall Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n\n")

oof_best$PANDAS_binary <- ifelse(oof_best$obs == "PANDAS", 1, 0)

roc_pandas <- roc(response = oof_best$PANDAS_binary, predictor = oof_best$PANDAS, levels = c(0, 1))
roc_fig2_svm_cov <- roc_pandas

plot(roc_pandas, main = "PANDAS vs Rest ROC - SVM Radial with Demographics")
auc_pandas <- auc(roc_pandas)

multiclass_roc <- multiclass.roc(response = oof_best$obs, predictor = as.matrix(oof_best[, c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")]))
auc_multiclass <- auc(multiclass_roc)

cat("PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_pandas), 3), "\n")
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n\n")

youden <- coords(roc_pandas, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"), best.method = "youden")
cat("--- Optimal Threshold (Youden's Index) ---\n")
cat("Threshold:", round(youden$threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(youden$sensitivity, 3), "| Specificity:", round(youden$specificity, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05 <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.5, 1, 0)
pred_085 <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= 0.85, 1, 0)
pred_youden <- ifelse(oof_best$PANDAS >= youden$threshold, 1, 0)

pred_05 <- factor(pred_05, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_085 <- factor(pred_085, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_youden <- factor(pred_youden, levels = c(1, 0))
actual_binary <- factor(oof_best$PANDAS_binary, levels = c(1, 0))

cm_05 <- table(Predicted = pred_05, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_085 <- table(Predicted = pred_085, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_youden <- table(Predicted = pred_youden, Actual = actual_binary)

sens_05 <- cm_05[1, 1] / sum(cm_05[, 1])
spec_05 <- cm_05[2, 2] / sum(cm_05[, 2])
sens_085 <- cm_085[1, 1] / sum(cm_085[, 1])
spec_085 <- cm_085[2, 2] / sum(cm_085[, 2])
sens_youden <- cm_youden[1, 1] / sum(cm_youden[, 1])
spec_youden <- cm_youden[2, 2] / sum(cm_youden[, 2])

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
print(cm_05)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold =", round(youden$threshold, 3), ", Youden) ---\n")
print(cm_youden)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_youden, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
print(cm_085)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n\n")

cat("\n--- Variable Importance (Permutation-based) ---\n\n")

library(iml)
conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

predictor <- Predictor$new(svm_model, data = sd[, -1], y = sd$Diagnosis)
feat_imp <- FeatureImp$new(predictor, loss = "ce")
plot(feat_imp)

detach("package:iml", unload = TRUE)

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("Best tuning parameters: C =", svm_cv$bestTune$C, ", sigma =", round(svm_cv$bestTune$sigma, 4), "\n")
```

# 7. Gradient Boosting -- No Covariates

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Gradient Boosting -- No Covariates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)

xgb_data <- PrimaryModelTwo[, c("Diagnosis", protein_columns)]
xgb_data$Diagnosis <- gsub("AN/ARFID", "AN_ARFID", xgb_data$Diagnosis)
xgb_data$Diagnosis <- factor(xgb_data$Diagnosis, levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID"))

colnames(xgb_data) <- make.names(colnames(xgb_data), unique = TRUE)

cat("========== XGBOOST: PANDAS vs OCD vs AN_ARFID ==========\n\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(xgb_data), "\n")
print(table(xgb_data$Diagnosis))
cat("\n")

class_counts <- table(xgb_data$Diagnosis)
class_weights <- sum(class_counts) / (length(class_counts) * class_counts)
sample_weights <- as.numeric(class_weights[xgb_data$Diagnosis])

cat("--- Cross-Validation Setup ---\n")
cat("Method: 10-fold CV with 10 repeats\n")
cat("Parameters (conservative for small sample):\n")
cat("  eta = 0.1, max_depth = 3, subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8\n\n")

X <- as.matrix(xgb_data[, -1])
y <- as.numeric(xgb_data$Diagnosis) - 1

params <- list(
  objective = "multi:softprob",
  eval_metric = "mlogloss",
  num_class = 3,
  eta = 0.1,
  max_depth = 3,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  gamma = 0
)

oof_probs_all <- array(0, dim = c(nrow(xgb_data), 3, 10))

for (rep in 1:10) {
  folds <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = nrow(xgb_data)))
  
  for (fold in 1:10) {
    train_idx <- which(folds != fold)
    test_idx <- which(folds == fold)
    
    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X[train_idx, ], label = y[train_idx], weight = sample_weights[train_idx])
    dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X[test_idx, ], label = y[test_idx])
    
    model <- xgb.train(
      params = params,
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = 100,
      verbose = 0
    )
    
    preds <- predict(model, dtest)
    pred_matrix <- matrix(preds, ncol = 3, byrow = FALSE)
    oof_probs_all[test_idx, , rep] <- pred_matrix
  }
}

oof_probs <- apply(oof_probs_all, c(1, 2), mean)
colnames(oof_probs) <- c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")

oof_pred_class <- factor(c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID")[apply(oof_probs, 1, which.max)], 
                         levels = c("PANDAS", "OCD", "AN_ARFID"))

cat("--- Cross-Validated Performance (Out-of-Fold) ---\n\n")

cat("--- 3-Class Confusion Matrix ---\n")
cm_3class <- table(Predicted = oof_pred_class, Actual = xgb_data$Diagnosis)
print(cm_3class)
cat("Overall Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n\n")

pandas_binary <- ifelse(xgb_data$Diagnosis == "PANDAS", 1, 0)

roc_pandas <- roc(response = pandas_binary, predictor = oof_probs[, "PANDAS"], levels = c(0, 1))
roc_fig2_gbm <- roc_pandas
plot(roc_pandas, main = "PANDAS vs Rest ROC - XGBoost")
auc_pandas <- auc(roc_pandas)

multiclass_roc <- multiclass.roc(response = xgb_data$Diagnosis, predictor = oof_probs)
auc_multiclass <- auc(multiclass_roc)

cat("PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_pandas), 3), "\n")
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n\n")

youden <- coords(roc_pandas, "best", ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"), best.method = "youden")
cat("--- Optimal Threshold (Youden's Index) ---\n")
cat("Threshold:", round(youden$threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity:", round(youden$sensitivity, 3), "| Specificity:", round(youden$specificity, 3), "\n\n")

pred_05 <- ifelse(oof_probs[, "PANDAS"] >= 0.5, 1, 0)
pred_085 <- ifelse(oof_probs[, "PANDAS"] >= 0.85, 1, 0)
pred_youden <- ifelse(oof_probs[, "PANDAS"] >= youden$threshold, 1, 0)

pred_05 <- factor(pred_05, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_085 <- factor(pred_085, levels = c(1, 0))
pred_youden <- factor(pred_youden, levels = c(1, 0))
actual_binary <- factor(pandas_binary, levels = c(1, 0))

cm_05 <- table(Predicted = pred_05, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_085 <- table(Predicted = pred_085, Actual = actual_binary)
cm_youden <- table(Predicted = pred_youden, Actual = actual_binary)

sens_05 <- cm_05[1, 1] / sum(cm_05[, 1])
spec_05 <- cm_05[2, 2] / sum(cm_05[, 2])
sens_085 <- cm_085[1, 1] / sum(cm_085[, 1])
spec_085 <- cm_085[2, 2] / sum(cm_085[, 2])
sens_youden <- cm_youden[1, 1] / sum(cm_youden[, 1])
spec_youden <- cm_youden[2, 2] / sum(cm_youden[, 2])

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.5) ---\n")
print(cm_05)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_05, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_05, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold =", round(youden$threshold, 3), ", Youden) ---\n")
print(cm_youden)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_youden, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n\n")

cat("--- Binary Confusion Matrix: PANDAS vs Not-PANDAS (threshold = 0.85) ---\n")
print(cm_085)
cat("Sensitivity:", round(sens_085, 3), "| Specificity:", round(spec_085, 3), "\n\n")

cat("\n--- Final XGBoost Model ---\n\n")

dtrain_full <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X, label = y, weight = sample_weights)
xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_full,
  nrounds = 100,
  verbose = 0
)

cat("\n--- Feature Importance ---\n\n")

importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X), model = xgb_model)
xgb.plot.importance(importance_matrix, main = "Feature Importance - XGBoost")

importance_df <- importance_matrix %>%
  arrange(desc(Gain)) %>%
  mutate(Index = row_number())

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = Index, y = Gain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Elbow Plot of Feature Importance (Gain)") +
  xlab("Feature Index") +
  ylab("Gain")

cat("\n--- Inflection Point Analysis ---\n\n")

inflection::findipiterplot(importance_df$Index, importance_df$Gain, 2)

elbow <- inflection::findiplist(importance_df$Index, importance_df$Gain, 0)
inflection_index <- elbow["ESE", "j1"]

important_features <- importance_df$Feature[1:inflection_index]
important_features_xgb <- important_features
cat("Proteins before inflection point (based on ESE):\n")
print(important_features)

cat("\n========== SUMMARY ==========\n\n")
cat("Parameters: eta = 0.1, max_depth = 3, subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8, nrounds = 100\n")
cat("PANDAS vs Rest AUC:", round(as.numeric(auc_pandas), 3), "\n")
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n")
cat("3-Class Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.5: Sensitivity =", round(sens_05, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")
cat("At Youden threshold (", round(youden$threshold, 3), "): Sensitivity =", round(sens_youden, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.85: Sensitivity =", round(sens_085, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")
cat("Top", inflection_index, "features identified by inflection analysis:", paste(important_features, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Multi-class AUC (Hand-Till):", round(as.numeric(auc_multiclass), 3), "\n")
cat("3-Class Accuracy:", round(sum(diag(cm_3class)) / sum(cm_3class), 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.5: Sensitivity =", round(sens_05, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_05, 3), "\n")
cat("At Youden threshold (", round(youden$threshold, 3), "): Sensitivity =", round(sens_youden, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_youden, 3), "\n")
cat("At threshold 0.85: Sensitivity =", round(sens_085, 3), ", Specificity =", round(spec_085, 3), "\n")
cat("Top", inflection_index, "features identified by inflection analysis:", paste(important_features, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```
